strategy.title: No executable plan: no evidenced opening reaches $10,000 in 16 days
strategy.why: Templates sell at $9 (1,112 sales needed, no evidenced buyer volume or channel); the GitHub $10,000 figure is a bug-bounty reward, not a purchase price, and needs a critical vulnerability a spreadsheet cannot deliver; domain assistance is $75 per transaction with no evidenced volume.

alternatives.title: Sell spreadsheet templates at $9
alternatives.why: Would need 1,112 settled sales in 16 days; no reachable channel or buyer count is evidenced, Brain's supported reach is $9.

alternatives.title: Pursue GitHub bug bounty
alternatives.why: A bounty is a contingent reward, not a purchase; the deliverable (critical vulnerability) is not something the card's fulfilment produces, and payout timing is not established.

steps.label: Research buyer volume and a reachable channel for template sales, and discover openings with evidenced prices large enough to close the $10,000 gap

quantities.name: templateBuyerVolume
quantities.needs: A published count of reachable buyers (marketplace category sales) showing 1,112 sales feasible in 16 days

quantities.name: githubBountyAsPrice
quantities.needs: A purchase price GitHub pays for a deliverable, not a contingent bounty reward

sources.claim: Spreadsheet templates for small businesses sell for $9 on template marketplaces.
GitHub's public bug bounty program pays security researchers $10,000 for a critical vulnerability finding.
sources.population: Bug bounty researchers (reward, not a purchase)

sources.claim: Flat-fee domain brokers charge a service fee, often $75 per transaction.

noPlan.decisiveGap: No opening has an evidenced price times evidenced reachable volume that reaches $10,000 settled within 16 days: the only real price ($9 templates) has no evidenced buyer volume or channel (1,112 sales needed), the $10,000 GitHub figure is a bounty reward not a purchase price, and domain help is $75 per deal with no volume.
noPlan.resolution: Research a published, reachable buyer count for templates and discover openings with evidenced purchase prices of $1,000+ per deal and a reachable buyer population; alternatively lengthen the window or lower the target.

excluded.why: A bug bounty is a reward, not a purchase price; one organisation; fulfilment (critical vulnerability) not deliverable as a spreadsheet.
$75 per deal, no fulfiller or volume evidenced; cannot carry the target.

constraints.suggestion: Lower the target to an amount the evidenced openings can reach, or extend the 16-day DEADLINE while research establishes volume.
